solution.what: DigitArq details and rdigital APIs for PT/TT/CPN/0019/00001: hasImages false, 0 scan files. Not digitised.
Same check for the key volume PT/TT/MMCG/3L and its key leaves 3L/000003 and 3L/000020: not digitised.

Mapped MMCG 3L from the crawl: Miranda letters 14 Nov 1659 to 22 Oct 1660, 15 with cipher (f. 125 wholly), overlapping the copy-book's 1660 letters. Siblings CPN/0017/00001 (Orsini cipher), CPN/000210, CPN/002285 and a DigitArq search for other Miranda Hague items: nothing imaged.

known.py (repo, DECODE, Cryptoole) and web searches on the correspondents, the Hague embassy, the shelfmark and Cryptiana. No edition or decipherment. Found BL Add MS 38038 (Lisbon to Sande 1662-66, partly deciphered, not digitised). Prestage 1928 not checked.

outcome.notes: Not attempted on the ciphertext: the item and its keys could not be reached. Scans must be ordered from ANTT.
